answer: A sybil attacker creating many identities must fund every stake, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts while honest nodes pay once. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized bonded deposit into a shared vault before voting; identities are minted only after that collateral locks for several epochs. Any verified duplicate triggers a ripple through the offender's stake, slashing it and redistributing to peers, making mass reputation slot creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
